descriptions.preferred: Acer pseudosieboldianum Japanese Maple Rare Japanese Maple Zones 4b-9 Acer pseudosieboldianum is an exceptional maple that is cold tolerant and has a beautiful fall color. The green leaves turn to bright shades of yellow, orange and red in the fall. Acer pseudosieboldianum is highly prized by those in colder regions or anyone that has seen this vibrant fall color. Here we are offering Acer pseudosieboldianum on its own roots and ungrafted. This means these should be the most cold tolerant. While you may not be in a cold region, Acer pseudosieboldianum assures to be a beautiful upright tree that will surprise you with outstanding fall color. Acer pseudosieboldianum may reach 12 ft in height in 10 years. Protection from the hot afternoon sun is recommended in hotter climates for best growth and fall color. These 10 gallon trees are for local pickup only, we cannot ship them because they are too big. The MrMaple Nursery is located in East Flat Rock, NC. Please contact us to arrange a pickup time.

descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer pseudosieboldianum 日本枫，稀有日本枫，适生区 4b-9。Acer pseudosieboldianum 是一种极为出色的槭树，耐寒性强，且秋色优美。其绿色叶片在秋季会转为鲜亮的黄色、橙色和红色。Acer pseudosieboldianum 深受寒冷地区种植者以及所有见过其绚丽秋色的人喜爱。这里提供的是实生自根、未嫁接的 Acer pseudosieboldianum，因此理论上应具有更强的耐寒性。即使您并不处于寒冷地区，Acer pseudosieboldianum 依然会成长为优美的直立型乔木，并以出色的秋色带来惊喜。10 年内可长至约 12 英尺高。在较炎热地区，建议避开午后烈日，以获得最佳生长状态和秋季显色效果。此规格为 10 加仑容器苗，仅支持本地自提，因植株过大无法邮寄。MrMaple Nursery 位于北卡罗来纳州 East Flat Rock，请联系我们安排提货时间。数量有限。由于我们拥有上千个日本枫品种，每个品种通常库存不多，建议尽快购买心仪品种，因为部分选育品种经常很快售罄。
